preview.input: synthetic 45-product high-load fixture with four plottable efficacy product groups

browser: Ego Lite; direct ordinary rendered file pages; actual 1440/1600/1920/2560 CSS px, height 960
observations: At 1440 and 1600 the four groups occupy two readable columns; groups are 670 and 750 CSS px wide respectively, with no local or document horizontal overflow.
At 1920 and 2560 the existing two-column behavior remains; the four groups remain individually accessible.
At 1440 the overview's next safety section enters the first 960px viewport; the efficacy physical page also shows all four plotted groups and its full-table disclosure entry in the first viewport.
Eight simple safety groups remain separately labeled and all 24 visible event cards remain accessible; they use two columns at all four desktop widths, with no group or document overflow.

An ordinary page regenerated from the fixed offline PNH builder input (SHA-256 0d8acf15...) contains 799 efficacy groups and 35 safety groups; 60 efficacy and 17 safety groups are visible on page one. At 1440px the efficacy grid decreases from 7870 to 4672px with 0 overflow among 60 rows, including long labels up to 139 characters. Complex safety is intentionally full-width (5506px, unchanged) because a blanket two-column probe increased it to 6418px and made long event labels less readable.

Clicking the first product in the ordinary efficacy page opens the correct product drawer; Escape closes it and returns focus to the same product trigger. Clicking safety row safe-fixture-teae also opens that product and Escape returns focus to the same safety button.
